title: Hemi Bro wallet check: nonce/sign/verify round trip
oneLine: One-at-a-time wallet verification: idle, pending (wallet prompt and chain read), ok, error, with a 90 s timeout.
topConcern: A timed-out attempt's late signature is sent anyway and its refusal settles the next attempt; answers carry no attempt id.

title: The game socket's lifecycle: connect, open, reconnect, stop, tear down
oneLine: One closure `ws` shared by every socket; a 15-value status shadow; reconnect roads that do and don't detach.
topConcern: Undetached orphan sockets (Retry now, lockout timer, cleanup) later reconnect over the live one; the tab then reads 'superseded' while joined, watchdog off.

title: Join refusals: a message records why, the following close acts on it
oneLine: Eleven refusal holders set by messages and consumed by onclose in a fixed priority order, also keyed by close code.
topConcern: Server closes 4010 for both a linger and a thrown join; the client reads every 4010 as linger: wrong screen, fixed 5 s retry forever.

title: Server-ready gate and the connect veil
oneLine: Whether the world may be shown: waiting, ready, not-ready (caps), lost; veil after a grace timer; _netHold freezes movement.
topConcern: A drop while the loading screen is up skips the veil and never re-arms it; the world shows frozen, unexplained, for the outage.

title: Dead-pipe and stalled-connect watchdog, strikes held for the rejoin
oneLine: 1 s heartbeat judging silence, unanswered settled sends, stuck connects and page freezes; replays one unanswered strike after a rejoin.
topConcern: The first connect's lobby fetch has no timeout and no socket exists meanwhile, so nothing retries while the loading screen says we keep trying.

title: Coming back to the tab: resume / resync / graphics-probe ladder
oneLine: visibilitychange, pageshow and the heartbeat's thaw all run one recovery: reload, reconnect, force rejoin, renderer rebuild.
topConcern: Its 'may I reconnect?' exclusion is only superseded/idle, so a tab return rejoins origin, device, key, frozen and fatal-rejected tabs.

title: This device's identity: active Login Key, player id, stash and regen
oneLine: Which character the origin boots and joins as: bt_passphrase, its id, the _prev stash, bt_key_ids, bt_device, the auth regen.
topConcern: The join pairs the tab's in-memory id with the shared stored key; after another tab switches character, a reconnect gets 'auth' and mints new identities.

title: Login-key rotation: key_new, the old key kept, confirm or fall back
oneLine: Eight-word keys handed to a phone; old key kept until a new-key join gets in; door ask and fallback once.
topConcern: Each origin is its own device, so each origin playing an old key gets its own new key; the mirror shows duplicate rows.

title: The device's character roster and its cross-origin cookie mirror
oneLine: Rows of Login Keys with provisional/looked/look flags, merged across localStorage, a shared cookie with tombstones, and bt_key_ids.
topConcern: A remote tombstone deletes the origin's active row; its 30 s heartbeat re-adds it and strips the tombstone, undoing deletes and resurrecting rotated-out keys.

title: Waiting rooms: the world-is-full queue and the linger countdown
oneLine: Two DOM waiting screens retrying on their own cadence through the shared reconnect timer until a state_sync admits the player.
topConcern: 'Retry now' calls connect() without checking a socket already in its handshake, orphaning it.

title: Idle logout and 'I'm back' on the first touch
oneLine: Two-state latch: logged out with armed listeners and a banner, back on any touch or the next ready state_sync.
topConcern: A fallback-timer harvest strike after the logout can bring an abandoned tab back once by itself.

title: The account check gate (Turnstile before a character is made)
oneLine: verify refusal -> widget -> spend-once token -> next join; retry button and attempts counter.
topConcern: A tab return re-joins token-less, is refused, and shows the 'didn't go through' copy though nothing was tried.

title: The quiet phone's outbox: one frame per turn, riders with deadlines
oneLine: Per-socket outbox and riders gated on this socket's caps; reset each open; due riders go alone or drop.

title: Input batching and move pacing
oneLine: Latest-move holder and event buffer drained every 33 ms, with seen/solo/quiet/diet/path rate rules per batch.
topConcern: A move or event buffered as the socket closed is sent after the next join, which the worker drops before session.id.

title: Caps negotiation and the client's deploy-order gates
oneLine: S._serverCaps and ~30 module flags re-derived each state_sync, edited live by client_off and move_path.
topConcern: Module-level flags hide which worker a number was computed for; between a reconnect's open and state_sync they describe the previous worker.

title: Other players' presence: listed, parked, near, ghost, gone, and the count
oneLine: Peers made by six messages, removed by four, parked by presence v2, swept after 10 s; count has eight writers.
topConcern: The online count uses four formulas; a leave for a never-held id decrements anyway, drifting below the map until a keys-based write.

title: Server-authority mode flags and zone snapshots (v1 trio and v2 zone_state)
oneLine: _serverMonsters/_serverGatherNodes/_serverLoot flip legacy client paths on and off at state_sync and zone snapshots.
topConcern: state_sync replaces monsters without the stale-zone check its zone applier has; a rejoin that doesn't hold movement can land the old zone's list.

title: Per-tick monster mirror: alive/dead/respawn edges and timed phases
oneLine: Server monster deltas turned into edges and timers on the client's copies: death, respawn, stun, swell, burrow, aggro.
topConcern: The tick's death edge pushes a client-rolled loot pile ungated by _serverLoot; slime-boss pops leave phantom piles credited locally.

title: Adopting the worker's player_state over the client's prediction
oneLine: About 40 fields each adopted by its own rule: present-gated, absent-off, upward-only, latched, or applied last.
topConcern: After the player cycles slots once, the server's activeSlot is ignored all session, though the worker itself resets it to melee on an unequip.

title: Worn vs in-the-bag gear: rescue, quest stash, drops, shield adoption
oneLine: Worker owns worn slots, client its bag; each echo bags a displaced piece once unless an NML loss is recent.
topConcern: A lost nml_loss turns a confiscation into a rescue: phantom pieces in the bag that the server refuses on re-offer.

title: The player's own death and respawn (client side)
oneLine: _dying set by player_died, cleared by one shared respawn routine from the message or the stuck-dead watchdog.

title: Picking up a ground pile: asked, refused, credited, despawning
oneLine: Per-pile pending flags with watchdogs, three refusal buckets and a fast-retry budget; credit despawns after 500 ms.
topConcern: Death piles use the worker's wall-clock windows; a phone clock running ahead asks early, gets 'not-recipient', and drops the bag for good.

title: Other players' per-tick activity edges
oneLine: Harvest, sprint, board, pose, skull, pet, armour grade and badge edges from each tick entry; slim entries handled deliberately.

title: The worker's refusal of an ability: cooldowns and the swing given back
oneLine: Cooldown-until, swing-suppression-until and whirlwind windup corrected to the worker's answer; prediction only.

title: The per-session HTTP token for economy POSTs
oneLine: Token minted per join, rotated on every rejoin, held by the client until the next state_sync.
topConcern: A POST between a rejoin's open and its state_sync carries the old token and is refused (fails closed).

title: Onboarding seen flags carried across origins on cookies
oneLine: Monotone once-per-browser flags (welcome, coach lessons, skip) in localStorage and a shared-domain cookie, read as either.
